Subject: [Alert] P95 oscillation in us-west-2 — recurring every 10m

Team,

We observed a repeating p95 latency spike across gen-api endpoints in us-west-2 starting 09:06 PST. Pattern: ~3m elevated p95 every ~10m for the last 40m. Throughput for several tenants dropped ~25% during spikes; queues on front-end proxies increased.

Attachments: p95-digests.csv (sampled histograms)

Initial signals:
- CPU on worker-pool-b shows short-lived saturation concurrent with spikes.
- KV miss rate increases at each spike; KV warmup metrics show TTL refresh storms.
- Autoscaler shows throttle cycles (scale-up then immediate scale-down).

Ask:
1) Open an incident bridge? (high impact to a handful of high-throughput tenants)
2) Short-term mitigations we can flip: conservative batching, temporary route to dedicated capacity, or enable a fallback model variant.

I'll stand up a bridge if we agree; posting diagnostics to the ops channel now.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
SRE, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: eng-runtime@redwood.com

Subject: Re: [Alert] P95 oscillation in us-west-2 — recurring every 10m

On Tue, Feb 14, 2028 at 09:12 AM soojin_lee@redwood.com wrote:
> We observed a repeating p95 latency spike...

Quick triage notes:
- Wins: pattern looks like fanout amplification + KV cold-start. When autoscaler scales, new replicas have empty KV and cause synchronous upstream calls.
- Hypothesis: request-burst -> autoscaler -> new replicas -> KV misses -> added latency -> drop in throughput -> scale down -> repeat.

Immediate mitigations I can enact (low-risk):
- Increase autoscaler stabilization window to 5m for the affected pool (instant config flip).
- Pre-warm KV on new nodes using a short background loader for suspect tenants.
- Flip route for heavy tenants (Loopline) to the quantized-low-latency model variant (Q4) for next 2 hours.

Costs: routing to dedicated capacity requires product sign-off (billing/comms). I will open JIRA OPS-4126 and start configs. If we want fallback for all tenants, need product ok.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Software Engineer, Runtime

- Approve temporary route of Loopline (high QPS tenant) to Q4 quantized variant for 2 hours. CS, please prepare customer note and opt-in toggle instructions.

Roadmap asks (document these in OPS-4126):
- Autoscaler hysteresis: implement a rate-limiter on scale-down and integrate queue-depth signals (priority)
- KV warmup: pre-populate hot prefixes for known heavy tenants at replica-create time
